metaTitle: Caloorie — AI calorie tracker: snap your plate, know what you ate
metaDescription: Take a photo of your meal and Caloorie estimates the grams, calories and macros of every item. 10-day free trial on Android.
heroTitle:
Snap your plate.
Know what you ate.
heroLead: Take a photo of your meal and Caloorie identifies each item, estimates the grams and works out calories and macros — no scales, no endless searching.
howTitle: Logging a meal takes seconds, not minutes.
step1Text: Photograph your plate, pick one from your gallery, or just say or write what you had — “two eggs and toast” works fine.
step2Text: Each item gets its own estimated weight, calories, protein, carbs and fat, added up into a clear total.
step3Text: Watch your day fill up against your targets, log your weight weekly, and let your goal adjust as you go.
f1Text: Recognises every item on the plate and estimates portions, so mixed meals don’t need to be entered piece by piece.
f2Text: No photo? Just say what you ate, or type it in your own words, and get the same calorie and macro breakdown.
f3Text: Not sure what to eat next? Get ideas that fit what’s left of your calories and macros for the day.
f4Text: Log your weight each week. Caloorie reads your trend and suggests a calorie goal that matches how your body is actually responding.
f5Text: See each food’s NOVA group, so you know not just how much you ate but how processed it was.
f6Text: Export any day — or a longer period — as a clean PDF to share with your dietitian or keep for yourself.
pricingTitle: Try every feature free for 10 days.
pricingLead: Then pick the plan that suits you. Every plan includes everything.
pricingFine: Prices in USD. The price shown in Google Play in your country may differ.
a1: Yes. Every new account gets full access for 10 days before choosing a plan.
q2: How many meals can I analyse?
a2: Up to 50 AI analyses a day — photos, voice or text entries and meal suggestions combined — which is far more than everyday tracking needs.
a3: Caloorie is on Android today. The iPhone version is coming soon.
a4: Caloorie is available in 17 languages, and the AI answers and suggestions come in your language too.
a5: Subscriptions are managed through Google Play, so you can cancel anytime from your Play Store account.
ctaTitle: Your next meal is the easiest one to log.
ctaText: Download Caloorie and start your 10-day free trial.
